snippet.title: Hit Others - gameplay (HD)
snippet.description:
Download the free game at: http://hitothers.com

Upon arrival in the sleazy Bullerbar you have two life choices, escape or enjoy your stay. Party hard in the club, drink bullers, hit others or check out Bullerslug live on stage. But beware, Slugs can get angry when the music stops. And you don't want to make a Slug angry.

Hit Others is a MusicVideoGame made by artist Jan van Nuenen and musician Bastiaan Bosma. Music is made by dutch band Bullerslug.
